source_quotes: Caulfield is a suburb in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 10 km south-east of Melbourne's Central Business District, located within the City of Glen Eira local government area. Caulfield recorded a population of 5,748 at the 2021 census.
It served as a location for several grand mansions for wealthy Melbourne citizens over the following decades.
Major landmarks in the suburb of Caulfield include the Glenhuntly tram depot and Caulfield Hospital.
